title: Guest Service Fee Refund Cap Across a Guest's Stays
content:
# Guest service fee refund cap

**Rule.** For reservations in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the guest service fee refunded on a guest cancellation is capped across all of a guest's stays. Count the guest's other stays whose guest-cancellation refunds included a guest service fee refund dated within the cap window. When that count is below the cap of the stay's cancellation policy, the guest service fee of the current guest cancellation is refunded as the guest-cancellation refund rules compute it. When that count is equal to or greater than the cap, no guest service fee is refunded on the current guest cancellation and every other component is refunded unchanged.

**What is counted.** The window is the cap-window number of calendar days ending on, and including, the cancellation date of the current cancellation (the date part of its cancellation time), across every stay held by the same guest. The count is the number of distinct stays, other than the stay being cancelled, that carry a refund entry with the guest-cancellation reason, booked against the guest service fee, for an amount greater than 0.00, whose posting date falls inside the window.

**Which refunds the cap touches.** The cap applies only to refunds with the guest-cancellation reason, including non-payment lapses, which are refunded as guest cancellations. Host-cancellation, travel-issue, alteration and major-disruptive-event refunds are never capped and never counted.

## Cap figures by cancellation policy

| Cancellation policy | Cap (other stays counted) | Cap window | Major-disruptive-event refunds count toward the cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible | 3 | 365 calendar days | No |
| Moderate | 3 | 365 calendar days | No |
| Limited | 3 | 365 calendar days | No |
| Firm | 3 | 365 calendar days | No |
| Strict | 3 | 365 calendar days | No |
| Super Strict 30 Days | 3 | 365 calendar days | No |
| Super Strict 60 Days | 3 | 365 calendar days | No |
| Long-Term | 3 | 365 calendar days | No |

## Window edges (hypothetical dates)

For a hypothetical cancellation dated 2026-09-15, the 365-day window runs from 2026-09-16 of the previous year, that is 2025-09-16, through 2026-09-15, both days included. A guest-cancellation guest service fee refund posted on another stay on 2025-09-16 is counted; one posted on 2025-09-15 is not.

## Count and result

| Other stays counted in the window | Guest service fee on the current guest cancellation | Other components |
|---|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | refunded as computed | refunded unchanged |
| 3 or more | not refunded | refunded unchanged |

## Points of judgement

- Two guest service fee refunds on the same other stay make that stay count once: the count is of distinct stays.
- A guest service fee refund on another stay made because the host cancelled, or on an approved travel issue, does not enter the count.
- The stay being cancelled is never counted toward its own cap.
